mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months indicates the Federal Reserve is easing policy, lowering discount rates and increasing equity valuation multiples, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a risk-off reaction in equity markets, compressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate higher borrowing costs and tighter liquidity.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment benefits claims (PAYEMS) exceeding 5,000 over three months signals weakening labor demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and compresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in weakening labor demand are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) exceeding 105.7244 for three consecutive months indicates a robust supply-side expansion, which boosts investor confidence and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts index (HOUST) exceeding 1,669 units signals a strengthening housing market, which increases consumer wealth and corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in strengthening demand are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 6.3% for three months indicates a resurgent labor market, prompting the Federal Reserve to hold rates steady and supporting equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in recovery periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in retail employment (PAYEMS) above 142,631 for three months signals a strengthening labor market, which increases consumer spending and corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in strengthening labor demand are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) below 262.231 for three months indicates the Federal Reserve is likely to hold rates steady, supporting equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in low-inflation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
